headline: Record revenue and ARR overshadowed by a goodwill writedown
summary_short: Revenue rose 11% year over year to $972.0M on record annualized recurring revenue of $2.51B, but a $562.0M non-cash goodwill impairment in the Transportation & Logistics segment drove a GAAP net loss of $471.7M and diluted loss per share of $2.02.
summary_long: Revenue grew 11% year over year to $972.0M (10% organic), with gross margin expanding to 69.4% from 68.3%. GAAP operating income rose 3.3% y/y to $132.0M, but a $562.0M non-cash goodwill impairment tied to the Transportation & Logistics segment drove the company to a GAAP net loss of $471.7M and diluted loss per share of $2.02, versus non-GAAP net income of $200.3M and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.86. Free cash flow was $501.8M year-to-date. Cash fell to $214.4M from $265.9M a year earlier while long-term debt held roughly flat at $1,442.9M. Trimble raised full-year 2026 revenue and EPS guidance and authorized a new $1.0 billion share buyback.
confidence_notes: This is a force-regenerated run for TRMB US FY2026 Q2 (Step-0 exists-guard bypassed per explicit instruction); no prior summary file existed for this period, so this write is a fresh first print rather than an overwrite of prior content. GAAP net loss, negative pretax income, and negative EPS this quarter are driven by a one-time $562.0M non-cash goodwill impairment in the Transportation & Logistics segment, which management attributes to a sustained decline in market capitalization/stock price and lower market multiples for software businesses — not an operating deterioration. Non-GAAP net income ($200.3M) and non-GAAP operating income ($260.6M, 26.8% of revenue) were both up y/y, and the company simultaneously raised full-year 2026 guidance and authorized a new $1.0B buyback. Basic and diluted EPS are identical this quarter because the anti-dilutive effect of the net loss excludes dilutive securities from the diluted share count.

drivers.explanation: GAAP net loss driven largely by a $562.0M non-cash goodwill impairment tied to the Transportation & Logistics segment.
Diluted loss per share reflects the same $562.0M goodwill impairment recognized in the quarter.
Pretax loss driven by the T&L segment goodwill impairment, recorded in non-operating expense, net.
Release calls out record second-quarter gross margins but does not explain the specific driver; not explained in the release.
Growth attributed to strong recurring-revenue growth across all segments and continued execution of the Connect & Scale strategy, per the CEO's quote.

Underlying operating performance was record-setting (ARR, gross margin) but the T&L segment goodwill impairment, triggered by a sustained decline in market cap and lower software-sector multiples, pushed the company to a GAAP net loss for the quarter.
